289: It was learned: A priest who wants to raise his hands [to recite the priestly blessing] must add holiness to his holiness. As he must sanctify his hands by the hand of holiness. Who is the hand of holiness? That is the Levite. For the priest must receive the sanctification of water from his hands, as it is written, "And you shall sanctify the Levites." So they are holy. And it is written about them, about the Levites: And also with your kinsmen, the staff of Levi, [the tribe of your father], etc. (Numbers 18:2). As they are included in the tribe of your father. From this, [we learn] that every priest who raises his hands must be sanctified by the holy, to add holiness upon his holiness. And that is why he should not receive the sanctification of water from another person who is not holy.
